name: @pipeworx/mcp-genderize

tools.name: predict_gender
tools.description: Predict gender from a first name using global data. Returns predicted gender, probability (0–1), and sample size.

name.description: First name to predict gender for.

tools.name: predict_gender_country
tools.description: Predict gender from a first name in a specific country (e.g., "US", "FR", "DE"). Returns gender, probability, and regional sample size.

name.description: First name to predict gender for.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE") to localize the prediction.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-genderize forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the genderize pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
